## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 499 captures during June 2022. This figure represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity level provides the operational baseline for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes at the site. No additional activity categories or changes in service volume were recorded in the monthly information provided. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 13 were ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 2.6 per cent. The result is reported alongside overall capture activity to support routine monitoring of image quality. The available figures identify the number of ungradable images and the associated rate; they do not indicate a further breakdown by cause or equipment issue.

## Grading

A total of 114 results were graded referable during June 2022. The median grading lag was 24. This measure summarises the central grading wait for the month and should be considered with the reported activity and image-quality results. Together, the figures provide the site’s monthly position for capture volume, image usability and referable grading outcomes.
